findings.title: Preselect firmware targets from robot type
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #187 requests robot-model-based board/panel defaults while retaining manual override.
findings.exact_next_step: Define the authoritative robot-to-board/panel mapping, add GUI default/override tests, and verify no automatic flash occurs.

findings.title: Classify and expose safely hot-reloadable robot parameters
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #172 proposes runtime mutation across many owners; TF/topology and launch choices cannot be treated like scalar tuning.
findings.exact_next_step: Inventory each mowgli_robot.yaml owner and classify hot-reload/restart-only semantics before adding any parameter callback or GUI badge.

findings.title: Keep coverage turn radii physically trackable
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #499 traces lawn-digging turns to planner radii below half-track and below the controller's commandable radius; firmware safety authority is not the root cause.
findings.exact_next_step: Enforce planner/controller/drivetrain radius consistency with geometry tests and simulation, then validate swath-end turns on the mower.

findings.title: Implement configurable headland-pass count and crossing limit
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #497 requests effective multi-headland planning plus a configurable limit on how many passes transit may cross.
findings.exact_next_step: Confirm current planner semantics, define separate pass-count and crossing-limit parameters, and add plan-level geometry tests before implementation.

findings.title: Recover when the post-undock start pose is occupied
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #487 shows one lethal start pose causes every swath transit to be skipped and the area abandoned, while a later start completes the same area.
findings.exact_next_step: Add a deterministic occupied-start recovery/reposition acceptance case; use MN-DOCKING-001 evidence to avoid masking undock error.

findings.title: Reproduce and separate current mow-progress skips
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #445 mixes coverage skips with an older RTK-wait symptom; the GNSS subclaim is stale after the MGNSS remediation, but repeatable skipped lawn remains unresolved.
findings.exact_next_step: Reproduce on current HEAD, separate planner/progress persistence from RTK state, and create one deterministic finding per surviving failure mode.

findings.title: Restore an installable MAVROS backend image
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #423 reports installer selection of MAVROS with no available container image.
findings.exact_next_step: Reproduce the current installer path, identify registry/build ownership, publish or remove the unsupported option, and add an installer availability check.

findings.title: Reconcile the old Fields2Cover devcontainer fix
findings.analysis_summary: Open PR #252 targets an old devcontainer/Fields2Cover baseline and cannot be restored automatically.
findings.exact_next_step: Compare each PR #252 behavior with the current devcontainer lock/workspace layout, classify ALREADY_PRESENT versus ADAPT, and test a clean rebuild.

findings.title: Explain and bound undock BackUp distance
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #488 records variable fused displacement for the same BackUp command but does not yet distinguish physical overshoot from odom/fused disagreement.
findings.exact_next_step: Record wheel odom, Nav2 BackUp feedback, and fused displacement over one controlled undock to identify the owning layer before changing control.

findings.title: Make docking calibration achieve electrical contact
findings.analysis_summary: Issues #446 and #486 report the same Yardforce docking miss: geometric approach completes but charge contact remains absent.
findings.exact_next_step: Capture calibration pose, contact geometry, charge signal, and retry trajectory on the exact rig; correct the owning calibration/approach contract and revalidate contact.

findings.title: Identify PAC5210 auxiliary feedback semantics
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #289 deliberately exposes neutral raw bytes; their physical meaning remains unproven.
findings.exact_next_step: Run the documented stopped/rotation/speed/direction/load/Hall experiments on an exact hardware baseline before renaming or authorizing the fields.

findings.title: Add a 1 Hz-safe Waveshare LC29H DA preset
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #435 requests explicit LC29H DA cadence/liveness defaults; draft PR #438 implements a Universal-GNSS-based preset without a parallel driver.
findings.exact_next_step: Rebase PR #438 against the pinned Universal GNSS baseline, verify 1 Hz freshness and same-port RTCM/NMEA behavior, and run schema/startup/onboarding tests.

findings.title: Add a robot-shaped sensor health visualization
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #170 requests an operator-oriented schematic while retaining raw diagnostics.
findings.exact_next_step: Define a read-only data contract from existing typed telemetry, prototype accessible health states, and add deterministic component tests.

findings.title: Visualize localization covariance and sensor influence
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #168 requests one widget across fusion_graph and EKF, but true information gain is not uniformly exposed.
findings.exact_next_step: Inventory authoritative diagnostics for each backend, define truthful supported metrics and unknown states, then prototype without fabricating sensor dominance.

findings.title: Finish measured GUI energy reduction
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #430 has merged asset/log/test/default improvements, while map/effect proposals closed unmerged and direct macOS energy telemetry remains missing.
findings.exact_next_step: Capture repeatable macOS power/CPU/GPU/network measurements on current HEAD, then ADAPT only the still-material parts of #433/#439.

findings.title: Make dig detection measure wheel grinding and map displacement honestly
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #500 shows the detector misses 77% of field dig episodes because centre-distance cancellation and per-tick map path length mismeasure both sides; merged PRs #485/#489 are necessary but insufficient prior fixes.
findings.exact_next_step: Add deterministic pivot/asymmetric-wheel replay regressions, correct both distance measures, then validate detection latency and false positives on the recorded field baseline.

findings.title: Make wheel between-factor uncertainty distance-scaled
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #491 demonstrates cadence-dependent metre-scale covariance from a fixed per-node wheel sigma while the pose remains centimetre-accurate.
findings.exact_next_step: Define a distance-scaled noise model with floor, add 10/25/50 Hz equivalence tests, then field-check published covariance without changing estimator authority blindly.

findings.title: Review and integrate pending automated dependency upgrades
findings.analysis_summary: Thirteen Dependabot PRs cover independent frontend, Go, and GitHub Actions updates; they share one maintenance queue but are not semantic duplicates.
findings.exact_next_step: Rebase each PR independently, inspect upstream breaking/security notes, run its affected tests, and merge or reject it without batching unrelated failures.

findings.title: Provide a blade-safe Manual Drive mode
findings.analysis_summary: Issues #449/#451 share one safety contract: manual repositioning must keep blade authority off; draft PR #453 implements a distinct cross-layer mode.
findings.exact_next_step: Review/rebase PR #453, run interface/BT/bridge/firmware/GUI tests, then perform controlled hardware proof that no queued command can energize the blade.

findings.title: Keep manual teleop smooth without stale motion
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #450 identifies browser-frame gaps versus firmware timeout; draft PR #455 proposes a bounded relay lease and one-shot zero.
findings.exact_next_step: Review/rebase PR #455, prove lease/zero/disconnect timing deterministically, then validate smooth motion and stale-command stop on hardware.

findings.title: Add the landscape manual controller after safety prerequisites
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #452 and replacement draft PR #457 define the controller UI; safe enablement depends on Manual Drive and bounded teleop contracts.
findings.exact_next_step: Complete MN-MANUAL-001 and MN-MANUAL-002, then rebase PR #457 and validate responsive controls, mode gating, zero-on-loss, and field ergonomics.

findings.title: Prevent free phantom corridors between close areas
findings.analysis_summary: Open PR #346 proposes high-cost boundary slack after merged coverage fixes #340/#345; its old base requires adaptation to current map semantics.
findings.exact_next_step: Compare PR #346 with current map_server, rebase/adapt the cost semantics, run keepout regressions and simulation, then confirm route preference on the reported field geometry.

findings.title: Migrate ROS2 Kilted to Lyrical deliberately
findings.analysis_summary: Issue #448 lists Nav2/plugin/API and Ubuntu platform changes; this is a semantic migration, not a base-image bump.
findings.exact_next_step: Build a package/API compatibility matrix on a dedicated branch, classify each change PORT/ADAPT/SUPERSEDED, then run focused builds before simulation.
